title: Transcriptomics Data Mining to Identify Novel Regulatory Genes of Iron Uptake in Drought-Stressed Wheat.
authors: Saidi, Mohamed Najib; Rebai, Omeima; Hachani, Fadhila; Vigani, Gianpiero; Astolfi, Stefania
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组数据挖掘和共表达网络鉴定干旱与缺铁胁迫下小麦中调控铁吸收的转录因子基因，但仅基于序列表达统计，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心方法不匹配。
abstract: Understanding the molecular crosstalk between drought and iron (Fe) homeostasis is crucial for developing drought-tolerant wheat cultivars with enhanced nutrient quality. In this study, transcriptomic data mining identified 23,271 and 5933 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) under drought and Fe deficiency, respectively, with 2479 DEGs in response to both stresses. Notably, this overlapping set included significant numbers of genes encoding transcription factors (TFs) (149 genes), Fe homeostasis components (274 genes), and those involved in phytohormones pathways (245 genes), particularly the abscisic acid (ABA) pathway. Gene Ontology (GO) analysis revealed specific and commonly affected biological processes, such as response to abiotic stimulus and heme binding. Furthermore, co-expression network analysis revealed modules highly enriched with genes involved in transcriptional regulation and Fe uptake, enabling the identification of key hub regulatory genes, belonging to the MYB, NAC, BHLH, and AP2/ERF families, involved in the shared stress response. Finaly, the expression of a set of candidate TF-encoding genes was validated using qRT-PCR in durum wheat under drought and Fe starvation, providing a detailed overview of the possible shared regulatory mechanisms linking drought and Fe deficiency responses.
abstract_zh: 理解干旱与铁（Fe）稳态之间的分子串扰对于开发具有增强营养品质的耐旱小麦品种至关重要。在本研究中，转录组数据挖掘分别鉴定了干旱和铁缺乏条件下的23,271个和5933个差异表达基因（DEGs），其中2479个DEGs对两种胁迫均有响应。值得注意的是，这一重叠基因集包含大量编码转录因子（TFs）的基因（149个基因）、铁稳态组分（274个基因）以及参与植物激素途径的基因（245个基因），特别是脱落酸（ABA）途径。基因本体论（GO）分析揭示了特异性和共同受影响的生物学过程，如对非生物刺激的响应和血红素结合。此外，共表达网络分析揭示了高度富集于转录调控和铁摄取相关基因的模块，从而能够识别关键枢纽调控基因，这些基因属于MYB、NAC、BHLH和AP2/ERF家族，参与共享的胁迫响应。最后，在硬粒小麦中，通过qRT-PCR验证了一组候选转录因子编码基因在干旱和铁饥饿条件下的表达，为连接干旱和铁缺乏响应的可能共享调控机制提供了详细概述。
